content: PBO/CSCV limitation not emphasized in RESEARCH.md: PBO/CSCV validates only rank-degradation overfitting; it does NOT detect look-ahead bias, data leakage, or invalid features (separate audits needed), and it is blind to regime shifts absent from the historical sample - a PBO computed on a bull-only history says nothing about bear/chop robustness. CSCV requires the full candidate return matrix, is generic/non-parametric, and needs equal-sized IS/OOS slices.
